source_refs.note: 3- Termination Phase: a main subheading of The Phases of Transcription and mRNA Processing, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 135-135.

blocks.text: Template DNA par gene ke aakhir mein aik stop codon hota hai. Is ke baad stop region hota hai: pehle GC nucleotide pairs (base pairs) ka silsila, phir AT pairs ka silsila. Jab yeh hissa mRNA mein transcribe hota hai to mRNA strand ke andar hi hydrogen bonds ban jate hain. mRNA ke apne andar ki yeh base-pairing aik loop banati hai jise GC hairpin kehte hain, aur us ke baad chaar ya zyada U ribonucleotides ki dum (tail) hoti hai. GC hairpin RNA polymerase ko rok deta hai (pause). mRNA ke chaar U aur DNA ke A ka jor sab se kamzor hota hai, is liye is lambe waqfe mein yeh RNA-DNA hybrid ko thaam nahin sakta. Natija yeh ke RNA strand transcription bubble ke andar DNA strand se alag ho jata hai aur transcription ruk jati hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: RNA polymerase DNA ke stop region par ruka hua, mRNA ka UUUU sira stop region se jura, aur peeche mRNA mein GC hairpin. Alag khaane mein hairpin ka silsila: 5' C A, phir C G G C G C jo G C C G C G se jure hain, loop G G C U U aur 3' dum U U U U U. Neeche: polymerase azad, DNA strands dobara lipat gaye aur mRNA alag ho gaya.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.15: Transcription ka termination marhala (kitab ki Figure 19.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Polymerase paused, Stop region, GC hairpin, Polymerase released, DNA strands rewind, mRNA separates.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Stop region ke G-C hisse se bana mRNA khud par muR kar GC hairpin banata hai. Is se polymerase ruk jata hai, aur peeche kamzor A-U jore (UUUU) aasani se toot jate hain, is liye mRNA alag ho jata aur polymerase azad ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 19.15 mein aakhri qadam par “mRNA seperates” chhapa hai. Sahi spelling separates hai; hamare diagram mein yahi likha hai.
